name: access-scope
trade: Эрхийн scope нарийсахад хохирлын хүрээ буурна; олон assignment удирдах ажил нэмэгдэж болно. HA ба throughput нь энэ сонголтын гол ялгаа биш.

rows.en: An operator may inspect one production VM but no other VM. Which Reader assignment scope meets least privilege?
rows.mn: Оператор зөвхөн нэг production VM-ийг харах ёстой. Reader role-ийг хамгийн бага эрхээр ямар scope-д өгөх вэ?
rows.reason: Нэг resource scope нь зөвхөн тэр VM-д үйлчилнэ; өргөн scope бусад нөөцийг хамарна.

rows.en: An auditor must inspect every resource in one dedicated project resource group, including future resources, but no other project. Where should Reader be assigned?
rows.mn: Аудитор нэг төслийн тусгай resource group-ийн одоогийн ба ирээдүйн бүх нөөцийг харна, бусад төслийг харахгүй. Reader-ийг хаана оноох вэ?
rows.reason: Resource group нь төслийн бүх нөөцийг хамарна; нэг resource дутуу, subscription хэт өргөн.

rows.en: A cost and inventory team needs read access across all resource groups of one subscription, with no access to sibling subscriptions. Choose the scope.
rows.mn: Баг нэг subscription-ийн бүх resource group-ийг унших эрхтэй, бусад subscription-д эрхгүй байна. Scope сонго.
rows.reason: Subscription scope нь бүх resource group-д өвлөгдөнө; management group хэт өргөн.

rows.en: Auditors require Reader access across all current and future subscriptions placed under a finance management group. Minimize repeated role assignments.
rows.mn: Аудиторууд finance management group-ийн одоогийн ба ирээдүйн subscription бүрд Reader эрхтэй байна. Давтан assignment-ийг багасга.
rows.reason: Management group-ийн assignment нь доорх subscription-д өвлөгдөнө; доод scope-ууд нийт хүрээг хамрахгүй.

name: resource-controls
trade: Policy compliance нь role assignment-ийг орлохгүй. Төвлөрсөн дүрэм admin ажлыг багасгана; throughput/DR-ийн оронд governance шаардлага шийднэ.

rows.en: New resources must be rejected when deployed outside approved regions, even by resource Contributors. Which control addresses this?
rows.mn: Contributor ч зөвшөөрөөгүй region-д шинэ нөөц үүсгэх боломжгүй байх ёстой. Ямар control хэрэгтэй вэ?
rows.reason: Deny нь нийцээгүй deployment-ийг хориглоно; audit зөвхөн илрүүлнэ.

rows.en: A company wants to measure noncompliant resource configurations before enforcing restrictions. Existing deployments must continue. Choose the effect.
rows.mn: Компани хориг тавихаас өмнө нийцээгүй тохиргоог хэмжинэ. Deployment үргэлжлэх ёстой. Ямар effect вэ?
rows.reason: Audit нь зөрчлийг тэмдэглэнэ, deployment-ийг хориглохгүй; deny шаардлагыг зөрчинө.

rows.en: A contractor may manage VMs in a project but must not assign access to other users. Select the authorization mechanism rather than a configuration rule.
rows.mn: Гэрээт ажилтан төслийн VM-үүдийг удирдана, бусдад эрх олгохгүй. Тохиргооны дүрэм бус authorization mechanism сонго.
rows.reason: RBAC role нь зөвшөөрөх үйлдлийг тодорхойлно; Policy нь хэрэглэгчид VM удирдах эрх олгохгүй.

rows.en: Resources already meet access and compliance requirements. Finance only needs a department label for cost grouping, with no new enforcement. What should be added?
rows.mn: Эрх ба compliance хангагдсан. Санхүүд зардлыг бүлэглэх department шошго л хэрэгтэй, enforcement нэмэхгүй. Юу нэмэх вэ?
rows.reason: Tag нь ангиллын metadata; өөрөө access эсвэл deployment enforcement биш.

name: identity-lifecycle
trade: Хугацаатай эрх standing privilege-ийг бууруулна. Governance лиценз ба workflow-ийн admin зардлыг тооц; app latency/DR-ийг эдгээрээр шийдэхгүй.

rows.en: Administrators need eligible Azure roles that activate for two hours after approval, rather than permanent production access. What should you use?
rows.mn: Админууд production-д байнгын эрхгүй, зөвшөөрөл авсны дараа хоёр цаг идэвхжих eligible Azure role хэрэгтэй. Юу ашиглах вэ?
rows.reason: PIM нь хугацаатай, approval-той role activation өгнө; тогтмол review нь activation биш.

rows.en: Group owners must periodically confirm whether external guests still need access and remove access for rejected users. Which capability fits?
rows.mn: Group owner-ууд guest эрх шаардлагатай хэвээр эсэхийг тогтмол баталж, татгалзсан хэрэглэгчийн эрхийг хасна. Ямар боломж вэ?
rows.reason: Access reviews нь давтамжтай recertification; PIM activation болон sign-in control өөр зорилготой.

rows.en: Partners request a bundle of groups and enterprise applications with sponsor approval and automatic expiration. Which governance capability fits?
rows.mn: Түншүүд sponsor approval ба автоматаар дуусах хугацаатай group/application багц хүснэ. Ямар governance боломж вэ?
rows.reason: Entitlement management-ийн access package нь олон resource-ийн access lifecycle зохион байгуулна.

rows.en: Employees may access a cloud app only when MFA and device conditions are satisfied at sign-in. Which control evaluates these signals?
rows.mn: Ажилтан sign-in үед MFA ба device нөхцөлийг хангасан тохиолдолд cloud app-д орно. Ямар control вэ?
rows.reason: Conditional Access нь sign-in signal-аар шийдвэрлэнэ; access package эсвэл review дангаараа энэ нөхцөлийг шалгахгүй.

name: hybrid-auth
trade: Cloud authentication on-prem доголдлын хамаарлыг багасгана; PTA/federation нь on-prem availability ба удирдлагын ачаалалтай. Нууц үгийн бодлого сонголтыг шийднэ.

rows.en: Cloud sign-in must continue during an on-premises directory outage. Synchronizing derived password hashes is permitted. Minimize authentication infrastructure.
rows.mn: On-prem directory унтарсан ч cloud sign-in ажиллах ёстой. Password hash-ийн хувиргасан хуулбар sync хийхийг зөвшөөрсөн. Authentication infrastructure-ийг багасга.
rows.reason: PHS нь cloud-д authentication хийдэг; PTA/federation нь on-prem замаас хамаарна.

rows.en: Password validation must occur against on-premises AD at sign-in. The company forbids password hash synchronization and wants no federation farm. What fits?
rows.mn: Sign-in бүрийн password-ийг on-prem AD шалгана. Hash sync хориотой, federation farm хүсэхгүй. Юу тохирох вэ?
rows.reason: PTA agent on-prem AD-аар password шалгана; PHS бодлого зөрчинө, federation farm илүү ажилтай.

rows.en: An existing third-party identity provider must remain the authority and supply its custom sign-in process to Microsoft Entra ID. Which approach fits?
rows.mn: Одоо байгаа third-party IdP нь өөрийн custom sign-in процессыг хадгалж Entra ID-д authentication өгөх ёстой. Аль арга вэ?
rows.reason: Federation нь external IdP-д authentication шилжүүлнэ; PHS/PTA энэ custom IdP урсгалыг орлохгүй.

rows.en: A newly formed subsidiary has no AD DS, no legacy domain dependencies, and no identity synchronization requirement. Minimize identity infrastructure.
rows.mn: Шинэ салбар AD DS, legacy domain dependency, identity sync шаардлагагүй. Identity infrastructure-ийг багасга.
rows.reason: Cloud-only identity нь шаардлагагүй hybrid бүрэлдэхүүнийг арилгана; бусад нь on-prem directory-д зориулсан.

name: workload-credentials
trade: Managed identity credential rotation ажлыг багасгана. Shared identity blast radius-тай; service availability ба authorization-ийг тусад нь төлөвлөнө.

rows.en: A single Azure VM needs an identity whose lifecycle ends when that VM is deleted. Avoid storing credentials. Choose the identity type.
rows.mn: Нэг Azure VM устахад хамт устдаг identity хэрэгтэй. Credential хадгалахгүй. Ямар төрөл вэ?
rows.reason: System-assigned identity нь нэг resource-ийн lifecycle-тэй холбоотой.

rows.en: Several replacement compute instances need the same preauthorized identity, which must survive instance deletion. Avoid managing secrets.
rows.mn: Солигддог compute instance-ууд ижил урьдчилан эрхтэй identity ашиглана; instance устахад identity үлдэнэ. Secret удирдахгүй.
rows.reason: User-assigned identity бие даасан lifecycle-тэй, олон resource-д холбож болно.

rows.en: An external legacy daemon cannot use managed identity or workload federation. It supports certificate-based Entra authentication; shared secrets are prohibited. Choose a credential model.
rows.mn: Гаднын legacy daemon managed identity/federation ашиглаж чадахгүй, certificate-based Entra authentication дэмжинэ. Shared secret хориотой. Credential model сонго.
rows.reason: Certificate-тэй service principal боломжит supported арга; managed identity-ийн hosting шаардлага хангагдахгүй.

rows.en: An external automation platform supports OIDC trust with Entra ID. Eliminate stored client secrets and certificates. Choose the approach.
rows.mn: Гаднын automation platform Entra ID-тай OIDC trust дэмждэг. Client secret болон certificate хадгалахгүй болго. Арга сонго.
rows.reason: Federation нь trusted external token-ийг ашиглана; certificate эсвэл client secret хадгалах шаардлагагүй.

name: observability-signals
trade: Өгөгдлийн хэмжээ/retention нь cost-д нөлөөлнө; шаардлагатай signal-ийг сонгох нь query latency ба admin ажлыг багасгана. Telemetry нь backup биш.

rows.en: An operator needs minute-by-minute numeric CPU trends and a threshold alert, with no text search or request tracing. Which telemetry type is primary?
rows.mn: Оператор CPU-ийн минут тутмын тоон trend ба threshold alert хүснэ; текст хайлт/request tracing хэрэггүй. Үндсэн telemetry юу вэ?
rows.reason: Metric нь хугацааны дараалалтай numeric signal; log/trace илүү өөр хэрэгцээнд зориулагдсан.

rows.en: A security investigation needs detailed data-plane operations emitted by an Azure service, including operation results. Which signal should be routed?
rows.mn: Аюулгүй байдлын шалгалтад Azure service-ийн data-plane ажиллагаа ба үр дүнгийн дэлгэрэнгүй хэрэгтэй. Ямар signal routing хийх вэ?
rows.reason: Resource logs нь service operation-ийн дэлгэрэнгүй; Activity Log нь management-plane-д төвлөрнө.

rows.en: An auditor asks who changed a resource's configuration through Azure Resource Manager. Which source should be examined first?
rows.mn: Аудитор Azure Resource Manager-аар resource тохиргоог хэн өөрчилснийг асуув. Юуг эхэлж шалгах вэ?
rows.reason: Activity Log нь control-plane ажиллагааг бүртгэнэ; app trace/CPU metric энэ асуултад хариулахгүй.

rows.en: A request spans three microservices and fails in a dependency. Engineers need the correlated end-to-end execution path. Choose the signal.
rows.mn: Request гурван microservice дамжаад dependency дээр алдана. End-to-end холбоотой зам хэрэгтэй. Signal сонго.
rows.reason: Distributed trace нь request ба dependency correlation өгнө; тусгаар numeric metric нь замыг харуулахгүй.

name: log-destinations
trade: Storage retention cost, Log Analytics query cost, Event Hubs streaming capacity-ийг шаардлагаар сонго. Нэмэлт destination бүр удирдлага ба cost нэмнэ.

rows.en: Operations needs interactive KQL analysis of routed Azure resource logs. Choose the diagnostic setting destination.
rows.mn: Operations Azure resource log дээр interactive KQL query хийнэ. Diagnostic setting-ийн destination сонго.
rows.reason: Log Analytics workspace нь query хийх destination; archive/stream дангаараа KQL workspace биш.

rows.en: Compliance requires an inexpensive raw archive of diagnostic logs and does not require interactive queries. Choose the destination.
rows.mn: Compliance diagnostic log-ийн хямд raw archive хүснэ; interactive query хэрэггүй. Destination сонго.
rows.reason: Storage archive зорилгод нийцнэ; workspace query capability шаардлагагүй нэмэлт зардал болно.

rows.en: A third-party SIEM must continuously consume Azure diagnostic events through a streaming interface. Choose the destination.
rows.mn: Third-party SIEM Azure diagnostic event-ийг streaming interface-аар тасралтгүй авна. Destination сонго.
rows.reason: Event Hubs нь streaming integration; storage archive эсвэл workspace дангаараа энэ stream биш.

rows.en: The same logs must support KQL investigation and independent long-term raw archiving. No single destination meets both selected workflows. What should you configure?
rows.mn: Ижил log KQL шинжилгээ болон тусдаа урт хугацааны raw archive-д очно. Сонгосон хоёр workflow-д нэг destination хүрэхгүй. Юу тохируулах вэ?
rows.reason: Diagnostic settings олон destination руу routing хийж болно; зөвхөн нэгийг сонговол нэг шаардлага дутна.

name: alert-choice
trade: Metric alert latency ба log-query flexibility-г ялга. Alert rule/action group удирдах ажилтай; alert нь HA/DR-ийг өөрөө бий болгохгүй.

rows.en: A VM CPU metric crossing a threshold must trigger an alert. No cross-resource joins or event search are required. Select the rule type.
rows.mn: VM CPU metric босго давбал alert өгнө. Join/event search хэрэггүй. Rule төрөл сонго.
rows.reason: Metric alert нь numeric time series-д шууд тохирно; log query шаардлагагүй.

rows.en: An alert must combine failed requests with deployment logs using a KQL query. Select the rule type.
rows.mn: Failed request ба deployment log-ийг KQL query-аар холбож alert өгнө. Rule төрөл сонго.
rows.reason: Log search alert нь query-ийн үр дүнд суурилна; metric alert энэ join-ийг хийхгүй.

rows.en: Notify security whenever an Azure resource is deleted through the management plane. Select the rule type.
rows.mn: Management plane-аар Azure resource устах бүрд security-д мэдэгдэнэ. Rule төрөл сонго.
rows.reason: Activity log alert нь control-plane event-д хариулна; query шаардлагагүй шууд signal.

rows.en: Alert detection already works. The same email and webhook recipients must be reused across rules. Which shared component is missing?
rows.mn: Alert detection ажиллаж байгаа. Ижил email/webhook хүлээн авагчийг олон rule-д дахин ашиглана. Ямар shared component дутуу вэ?
rows.reason: Action group notification/action-ийг нэгтгэнэ; шинэ detection rule нэмэх нь recipient reuse биш.

name: governance-hierarchy
trade: Нэгдсэн hierarchy давтан policy/admin ажлыг бууруулна. Billing/access boundary ба lifecycle-г ялга; hierarchy өөрөө latency/DR шийдэхгүй.

rows.en: A policy baseline must apply to multiple subscriptions and future subscriptions organized under the same business unit. Which hierarchy level fits?
rows.mn: Policy baseline бизнес нэгжийн одоогийн болон ирээдүйн олон subscription-д үйлчилнэ. Ямар түвшин вэ?
rows.reason: Management group нь subscription-уудын дээрх governance scope.

rows.en: Two departments require separate Azure billing and subscription-level quotas. Resource lifecycle grouping alone is insufficient. What boundary should be used?
rows.mn: Хоёр хэлтэст тусдаа Azure billing ба subscription-level quota хэрэгтэй. Lifecycle бүлэглэлт хүрэлцэхгүй. Ямар boundary вэ?
rows.reason: Subscription нь billing/quota boundary; resource group энэ тусгаарлалтыг өгөхгүй.

rows.en: A web app and its supporting resources should be deployed and removed together within an existing subscription. Which grouping fits this lifecycle?
rows.mn: Web app ба supporting resource-уудыг нэг subscription дотор хамт deploy/remove хийнэ. Lifecycle-д ямар бүлэг тохирох вэ?
rows.reason: Resource group нь холбоотой resource-ийн lifecycle grouping; management group subscription-уудыг нэгтгэдэг.

rows.en: Finance needs to query cost by project across unrelated resource groups without moving resources or changing access. What should be standardized?
rows.mn: Санхүү нөөц шилжүүлэхгүй, эрх өөрчлөхгүйгээр олон resource group дамнасан төслийн зардлыг ангилна. Юуг стандартчилах вэ?
rows.reason: Tag нь cross-cutting metadata; hierarchy өөрчлөх шаардлагагүй.

name: vault-content
trade: Key Vault credential төвлөрүүлж admin ажлыг багасгана. Key operation latency ба availability-г тооц; secret-д private key string хадгалах нь key operation-той адил биш.

rows.en: An application must retrieve a legacy database password at runtime. The target cannot use Entra authentication. Which Key Vault object fits?
rows.mn: Legacy database Entra authentication дэмжихгүй тул app runtime үед password авна. Key Vault-ийн ямар object вэ?
rows.reason: Secret нь нууц text утгыг хадгална; key object нь password string retrieval-ийн оронд crypto operation-д зориулагдсан.

rows.en: A service must request cryptographic signing without retrieving private key material. Which Key Vault object should be used?
rows.mn: Service private key material татахгүйгээр signing operation хүснэ. Ямар object вэ?
rows.reason: Key object нь crypto operation өгнө; secret хэлбэрээр хадгалбал key material татах загвар болно.

rows.en: A team needs certificate lifecycle management, including X.509 certificate versions and renewal integration. Which object category fits?
rows.mn: Баг X.509 certificate version ба renewal integration бүхий lifecycle удирдана. Ямар object төрөл вэ?
rows.reason: Certificate object нь certificate lifecycle-д зориулагдсан; энгийн secret дангаар renewal workflow биш.

rows.en: Secrets are already stored correctly. An Azure app needs passwordless authorization to read them. Which addition addresses the missing requirement?
rows.mn: Secret зөв хадгалагдсан. Azure app тэдгээрийг credential хадгалахгүйгээр унших эрхтэй болно. Юу нэмэх вэ?
rows.reason: Managed identity ба тохирох RBAC access-ийг шийднэ; шинэ vault object үүсгэх нь authorization биш.

name: review-versus-activation
trade: Periodic review ба JIT нь өөр хугацааны хяналт. Лиценз/approval workflow нэмэгдэнэ; гүйцэтгэл, DR шаардлагыг тусдаа шийднэ.

rows.en: A manager must certify every quarter that each member still needs a project group. There is no privileged-role activation requirement.
rows.mn: Менежер улирал бүр project group-ийн гишүүн бүрт эрх хэрэгтэй эсэхийг батална. Privileged role activation хэрэггүй.
rows.reason: Review нь одоогийн membership-ийг дахин батална; activation шинэ session-ийн эрхийн тухай.

rows.en: An engineer should hold no active production role between incidents, but activate one for an approved maintenance window.
rows.mn: Инженер incident хооронд active production role-гүй, зөвшөөрсөн maintenance window үед идэвхжүүлнэ.
rows.reason: Eligible role + activation нь байнгын active privilege-ийг арилгана; улирлын review үүнийг орлохгүй.

rows.en: A supplier's project access bundle must end on a known contract date without waiting for the next quarterly review.
rows.mn: Нийлүүлэгчийн access bundle гэрээний тодорхой өдөр дуусна; улирлын review хүлээхгүй.
rows.reason: Package expiration нь тогтсон lifecycle төгсгөлийг автоматжуулна; review хугацаа нь contract end-тэй адил биш.

rows.en: Membership remains valid, but access must depend on sign-in risk and device conditions. Which control layer should change?
rows.mn: Membership хүчинтэй хэвээр, гэхдээ access нь sign-in risk/device нөхцөлөөс хамаарна. Аль layer өөрчлөх вэ?
rows.reason: Conditional Access нь access context-ийг үнэлнэ; membership review-ээр device condition шалгахгүй.

name: policy-effects
trade: Enforcement эхлэхээс өмнө нөлөөг хэмж. Remediation existing resource-д нэмэлт ажил/эрх шаардана; audit нь downtime үүсгэхгүй ч зөрчлийг засахгүй.

rows.en: A pilot must report configuration violations without blocking deployment or changing resources. Which policy behavior is appropriate?
rows.mn: Pilot тохиргооны зөрчлийг мэдээлэх боловч deployment хориглохгүй, нөөц өөрчлөхгүй. Ямар behavior вэ?
rows.reason: Audit зөвхөн compliance үнэлнэ; modify/deploy/deny нь өөр нөлөөтэй.

rows.en: New deployments with prohibited settings must fail rather than be silently corrected. Which policy behavior fits?
rows.mn: Хориотой тохиргоотой шинэ deployment чимээгүй засагдах бус fail болох ёстой. Ямар behavior вэ?
rows.reason: Deny request-ийг хориглоно; audit зөвхөн тэмдэглэнэ, modify нь өөрчилнө.

rows.en: A supported tag property should be automatically added or updated during resource requests, with remediation for existing resources. Which effect fits?
rows.mn: Дэмжигддэг tag property-г request үед автоматаар нэмж/засаж, existing resource-ийг remediation хийнэ. Ямар effect вэ?
rows.reason: Modify supported property-г өөрчилнө; deny засахгүй, audit өөрчлөхгүй.

rows.en: After evaluating a resource, a missing related configuration resource must be deployed when conditions match. Which effect fits?
rows.mn: Resource үнэлсний дараа нөхцөл хангахад байхгүй related configuration resource-ийг deploy хийнэ. Ямар effect вэ?
rows.reason: DeployIfNotExists related resource deploy хийдэг; modify нь property өөрчлөлтөд чиглэнэ.

name: access-plane
trade: Data plane ба management plane эрх тусдаа. Least privilege нь ажиллагааг нарийсгана; нэмэлт assignment admin ажилтай, HA/performance ялгаа биш.

rows.en: An auditor only needs to view Azure resource configuration, not download blobs or change configuration. Choose a built-in role.
rows.mn: Аудитор зөвхөн Azure resource configuration харна, blob татахгүй, тохиргоо өөрчлөхгүй. Built-in role сонго.
rows.reason: Reader management-plane read өгнө; blob data access-ийг автоматаар өгөхгүй.

rows.en: A reporting identity must read blob content using Entra authorization without modifying blobs or administering the account. Choose the role.
rows.mn: Reporting identity Entra authorization-аар blob content уншина, blob өөрчлөхгүй, account удирдахгүй. Role сонго.
rows.reason: Data Reader blob унших data action өгнө; энгийн Reader нь content access биш.

rows.en: An ingestion identity must read, write and delete blobs but must not grant other users access. Choose the role.
rows.mn: Ingestion identity blob уншиж, бичиж, устгана, бусдад эрх олгохгүй. Role сонго.
rows.reason: Data Contributor blob data үйлдлийг зөвшөөрнө; Reader write/delete хангахгүй.

rows.en: A delegated access team must manage Azure role assignments, rather than operate application data. Which role is designed for that task?
rows.mn: Access баг Azure role assignment удирдана, app data боловсруулах зорилгогүй. Аль role зориулагдсан бэ?
rows.reason: User Access Administrator access assignment удирдана; data role-ууд role assignment эрх биш.

name: monitoring-tool
trade: Query/dashboard нь incident diagnosis-д тусална; ingestion ба retention cost тооц. Visualization нь collection эсвэл backup-ийг орлохгүй.

rows.en: An engineer needs an interactive editor to run KQL over existing workspace logs and inspect individual records. Which tool fits?
rows.mn: Инженер workspace log дээр KQL бичиж record бүрийг шалгах interactive editor хүснэ. Ямар tool вэ?
rows.reason: Log Analytics нь KQL query interface; workbook нь report visualization-д чиглэнэ.

rows.en: Operations needs a shared interactive report combining queries, charts and parameters over monitoring data. Choose the presentation tool.
rows.mn: Operations query/chart/parameter хосолсон shared interactive report хүснэ. Presentation tool сонго.
rows.reason: Workbook interactive analysis/report зохион байгуулна; query editor дангаараа shared report биш.

rows.en: A developer needs application request, dependency and exception correlation for a web service. Which monitoring capability fits?
rows.mn: Developer web service-ийн request, dependency, exception correlation хүснэ. Ямар monitoring capability вэ?
rows.reason: Application Insights application performance telemetry-д чиглэнэ; Activity Log app dependency trace биш.

rows.en: An investigation concerns who changed a network resource through Azure Resource Manager, not application requests. Which source is relevant?
rows.mn: Шалгалт application request бус network resource-ийг ARM-аар хэн өөрчилсөн тухай. Ямар source хэрэгтэй вэ?
rows.reason: Activity Log нь management operation-ийг харуулна; application monitoring өөр давхарга.

name: sql-platform
trade: PaaS нь OS/patching ажлыг багасгана; VM нь control нэмэхдээ maintenance ба HA төлөвлөлт шаардана. Compatibility-г cost-оос өмнө шалга.

rows.en: A new application needs one relational database with no instance-level dependencies or OS access. Minimize patching and database infrastructure management.
rows.mn: Шинэ app нэг relational database хэрэгтэй, instance dependency/OS access байхгүй. Patching ба infrastructure удирдлагыг багасга.
rows.reason: SQL Database нь database-level PaaS; VM control шаардлагагүй, MI-ийн instance compatibility хэрэггүй.

rows.en: A SQL Server migration depends on SQL Agent and instance-level compatibility but not OS access. Minimize database platform administration.
rows.mn: SQL Server migration SQL Agent ба instance-level compatibility шаарддаг, OS access хэрэггүй. Platform administration-ийг багасга.
rows.reason: MI нь managed instance compatibility өгнө; single SQL Database instance feature-ийг адил хангахгүй.

rows.en: A vendor requires SQL Server plus installation of a custom OS-level agent and full OS control. Which deployment meets the non-negotiable requirement?
rows.mn: Vendor SQL Server-ийн OS-д custom agent суулгах ба full OS control шаардсан. Аль deployment заавал нөхцөлийг хангах вэ?
rows.reason: VM OS control өгнө; managed database нь guest OS-д custom agent суулгах эрх өгөхгүй.

rows.en: A SaaS provider has many independent databases whose peaks occur at different times. Pool compute to reduce provisioned idle capacity without merging data.
rows.mn: SaaS олон тусдаа database-тай, peak нь өөр цагт. Data нэгтгэхгүйгээр сул compute-ийн зардлыг бууруул.
rows.reason: Elastic pool нь олон database-д shared compute budget; тус бүр peak provision хийхээс үр ашигтай байж болно.

name: sql-compute
trade: Peak concurrency ба idle хугацаа cost-ийг шийднэ; resume latency performance-д нөлөөлнө. HA нь service tier тохиргооноос мөн хамаарна.

rows.en: One database is continuously busy with predictable sustained demand and must avoid auto-resume delays. Choose the compute arrangement.
rows.mn: Нэг database тогтмол өндөр ачаалалтай, auto-resume саатал зөвшөөрөхгүй. Compute arrangement сонго.
rows.reason: Provisioned compute нь байнгын ачаалалд нийцнэ; auto-pause-ийн idle хэмнэлт энд бага.

rows.en: A supported single database is unused for long periods. It has no auto-pause blockers, accepts resume delay, and prioritizes reducing idle compute charges.
rows.mn: Дэмжигддэг single database удаан idle, auto-pause blocker байхгүй, resume delay зөвшөөрнө. Idle compute charge бууруул.
rows.reason: Serverless auto-pause idle compute-ийг бууруулна; storage төлбөр үлдэнэ, resume latency trade-off.

rows.en: Fifty databases have short, non-overlapping peaks and should share a managed compute budget while remaining logically separate. Choose the arrangement.
rows.mn: 50 database богино, давхцахгүй peak-тэй, тусдаа хэвээр shared managed compute budget ашиглана. Arrangement сонго.
rows.reason: Elastic pool олон database-ийн compute-ийг хуваалцана; нэг serverless database бусдыг pool хийхгүй.

rows.en: Several critical databases peak simultaneously and require independently reserved compute budgets with no shared-pool contention. Choose the arrangement.
rows.mn: Чухал database-ууд зэрэг peak хүрнэ, shared pool contention-гүй тус тусдаа compute budget шаарддаг. Arrangement сонго.
rows.reason: Тусдаа compute нь нэг pool-ийн өрсөлдөөнийг арилгана; зардал нэмэгдэх боломжтой.

name: consistency-guarantees
trade: Consistency чангарахад latency/availability trade-off үүснэ. Хамгийн сул боловч шаардлага хангах guarantee сонго; app logic-ийн ажлыг тооц.

rows.en: Every read must return the latest committed write globally; accepting weaker guarantees is prohibited. Which Cosmos DB consistency is required?
rows.mn: Read бүр globally хамгийн сүүлийн committed write-ийг буцаах ёстой; сул guarantee зөвшөөрөхгүй. Cosmos DB consistency сонго.
rows.reason: Strong нь latest committed read guarantee; session зөвхөн session дотор, bounded staleness хоцролт зөвшөөрнө.

rows.en: Readers may lag, but only within a configured time or version bound across clients. Choose the weakest listed consistency that guarantees this bound.
rows.mn: Уншилт хоцорч болно, гэхдээ бүх client-д тохируулсан time/version bound-оос хэтрэхгүй. Хангах хамгийн сул сонголт вэ?
rows.reason: Bounded staleness explicit lag bound өгнө; session/eventual global lag bound өгөхгүй.

rows.en: A shopping client must read its own writes within its session. Global latest-write visibility is unnecessary. Choose the weakest listed guarantee that meets this.
rows.mn: Shopping client өөрийн session дотор бичсэнээ уншина. Global latest write хэрэггүй. Хангах хамгийн сул guarantee сонго.
rows.reason: Session read-your-writes өгнө; eventual батлахгүй, strong/bounded илүү шаардлага тавина.

rows.en: A public counter tolerates temporary stale and out-of-order reads. Only eventual convergence is required. Choose the least restrictive consistency.
rows.mn: Public counter түр stale ба out-of-order read зөвшөөрнө. Эцэстээ ижил болох л шаардлагатай. Хамгийн сул consistency вэ?
rows.reason: Eventual convergence өгнө; бусад нь шаардлагагүй илүү баталгаа шаардана.

name: cosmos-ordering
trade: Ordering ба freshness өөр ойлголт. Сул consistency нь read performance-д тустай байж болох ч app stale data-г зохицуулна; HA/latency бүсээс хамаарна.

rows.en: A feed may be stale but must never expose writes out of order. No read-your-writes or lag bound is needed. Choose the weakest listed level.
rows.mn: Feed stale байж болно, write дараалал алдагдахгүй. Read-your-writes/lag bound хэрэггүй. Хангах хамгийн сул түвшин вэ?
rows.reason: Consistent prefix нь дарааллыг хадгална; eventual дараалал батлахгүй.

rows.en: A user updates a profile and must immediately observe that update in the same session; other users may see older data. Choose the weakest listed level.
rows.mn: User profile-оо update хийгээд ижил session-д шууд харна; бусад user хуучин data харж болно. Хамгийн сул тохирох түвшин вэ?
rows.reason: Session нь тухайн session-ийн read-your-writes; prefix нь өөрийн write харагдахыг батлахгүй.

rows.en: All readers must be no more than a configured number of versions behind, although they need not always see the latest version. Which level fits?
rows.mn: Бүх reader тохируулсан version тооноос илүү хоцрохгүй, latest version үргэлж шаардлагагүй. Аль түвшин вэ?
rows.reason: Bounded staleness нь version lag-ийг хязгаарлана; session/prefix тоон lag bound байхгүй.

rows.en: A business rule rejects any stale read, including reads from unrelated clients. Choose the consistency that enforces the requirement.
rows.mn: Бизнесийн дүрэм хамааралгүй client-ийн read ч stale байхыг хориглосон. Ямар consistency шаардлагыг enforce хийх вэ?
rows.reason: Strong global latest committed data батална; бусад түвшин тодорхой stale read зөвшөөрнө.

name: blob-access-tier
trade: Storage price ба retrieval/transaction cost-ийг нийлүүлж тооц; archive retrieval latency өндөр. Tier нь redundancy эсвэл backup биш.

rows.en: Customer images are read frequently throughout each day. Immediate online access is required and retrieval charges matter more than minimum storage price.
rows.mn: Customer зураг өдөржин байнга уншигдана. Шууд online access хэрэгтэй, хамгийн бага storage price-аас retrieval cost чухал.
rows.reason: Hot нь frequent access-д чиглэнэ; хямд хадгалалтын tier retrieval cost нэмэгдүүлж болно.

rows.en: A supported blob dataset is expected to remain for 45 days and is rarely read, but must stay online. Choose a tier aligned with the 30-day minimum rather than 90 or 180 days.
rows.mn: Blob dataset 45 хоног хадгалагдаж ховор уншигдана, online байна. 90/180 бус 30 хоногийн minimum-тэй tier сонго.
rows.reason: Cool 30-day minimum-тэй; cold/archive богино хадгалалтын early deletion cost үүсгэж болно.

rows.en: Data will remain for 120 days with very infrequent reads. It must be online; choose the online tier designed for a 90-day minimum retention horizon.
rows.mn: Data 120 хоног маш ховор уншигдана. Online байх бөгөөд 90 хоногийн minimum retention horizon-той tier сонго.
rows.reason: Cold нь online, 90-day minimum; archive offline, cool өөр minimum-тэй.

rows.en: Records will remain untouched for years. Retrieval can take hours and online access is unnecessary. Minimize storage charges among these tiers.
rows.mn: Бүртгэлүүд олон жил ашиглагдахгүй. Retrieval хэдэн цаг үргэлжилж болно, online access хэрэггүй. Storage charge багасга.
rows.reason: Archive offline storage хямд боловч rehydration delay/charge-тай; online tier шаардлагагүй.

name: storage-shape
trade: Access protocol ба data model эхэлж шийднэ. Managed storage admin ажлыг бууруулна; redundancy/throughput tier-ийг дараа нь тохируулна.

rows.en: An application stores large immutable image objects accessed over HTTP, with no shared file-system requirement. Which storage abstraction fits?
rows.mn: App HTTP-аар ханддаг том immutable image object хадгална, shared filesystem хэрэггүй. Ямар storage вэ?
rows.reason: Blob object storage тохирно; Files filesystem, managed disk VM block storage.

rows.en: Several application servers need a managed shared SMB file share without running their own file server. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Олон application server өөрсдөө file server ажиллуулахгүйгээр managed shared SMB share ашиглана. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: Azure Files SMB file share өгнө; blob HTTP object interface нь SMB share биш.

rows.en: A VM needs persistent block storage for its operating system and data volumes. Which service is designed for this?
rows.mn: VM OS ба data volume-д persistent block storage хэрэгтэй. Ямар service зориулагдсан бэ?
rows.reason: Managed disk нь VM block device; file share/object storage нь OS disk-ийн шууд орлуулагч биш.

rows.en: Workers need a simple large-scale queue of work items; ordering, transactions and publish-subscribe topics are not required. Choose a storage service.
rows.mn: Worker-уудад энгийн их хэмжээний work-item queue хэрэгтэй; ordering, transaction, topic хэрэггүй. Storage service сонго.
rows.reason: Queue Storage энгийн messaging abstraction; blob/files/disks queue semantics өгөхгүй.

name: data-model
trade: Data model ба query pattern нь performance/cost-ийг шийднэ. Өөр model руу хүчээр хувиргавал app/admin complexity нэмэгдэнэ; DR тусдаа дизайн.

rows.en: Orders require multi-table joins, constraints and transactional updates across related records. Which data model is the best fit?
rows.mn: Захиалгад multi-table join, constraint, холбоотой record-ийн transaction шаарддаг. Ямар model тохирох вэ?
rows.reason: Relational model нь холбоос/constraint/transaction-д нийцнэ; document/graph model нь энэ зорилгод илүү өөрчлөлт шаардана.

rows.en: A product catalog has heterogeneous nested JSON attributes and usually retrieves a complete product by ID. Which model fits naturally?
rows.mn: Product catalog ялгаатай nested JSON attribute-тай, ихэнхдээ ID-аар бүтэн product авна. Ямар model вэ?
rows.reason: Document model nested varied structure-д нийцнэ; fixed relational schema-д нэмэлт mapping шаардана.

rows.en: Fraud detection repeatedly traverses several hops of relationships between accounts and devices. Which model targets this access pattern?
rows.mn: Fraud detection account/device хоорондын олон hop холбоосыг байнга traverses хийнэ. Ямар model вэ?
rows.reason: Graph relationship traversal-д зориулагдсан; object/key-value нь traversal-ийг app-д шилжүүлнэ.

rows.en: A service retrieves opaque session payloads by exact key and does not query relationships or nested properties. Which model minimizes unnecessary query machinery?
rows.mn: Service opaque session payload-ийг exact key-ээр авна, relationship/nested property query хийхгүй. Аль model илүү тохирох вэ?
rows.reason: Key-value exact key lookup-д нийцнэ; relational/graph capability хэрэггүй.

name: integration-pipeline
trade: Batch latency ба streaming latency ялгаатай. Managed pipeline admin ажлыг багасгана; compute хэмжээ/transfer cost, retry/availability-г төлөвлө.

rows.en: Nightly data movement from on-premises SQL to a cloud lake requires scheduling, connectors and orchestration. Choose the main service.
rows.mn: Шөнө бүр on-prem SQL-ээс cloud lake руу data зөөж schedule/connector/orchestration хэрэгтэй. Гол service сонго.
rows.reason: ADF pipeline нь batch movement/orchestration; streaming ingestion дангаараа workflow биш.

rows.en: A Data Factory pipeline already exists but must reach a private on-premises source through a host under company control. Which runtime is needed?
rows.mn: ADF pipeline байгаа, company-ийн host-оор private on-prem source-д хүрэх ёстой. Ямар runtime вэ?
rows.reason: Self-hosted runtime private/on-prem connectivity өгнө; pipeline сонгох төдийд network reachability үүсэхгүй.

rows.en: Millions of telemetry events must be ingested continuously for multiple independent consumers, with replay over retained events. Choose the ingestion service.
rows.mn: Сая telemetry event тасралтгүй ingest хийгдэж олон consumer retained event-ийг replay хийнэ. Ingestion service сонго.
rows.reason: Event Hubs event stream ingestion/replay-д чиглэнэ; batch pipeline өөр хэрэгцээ.

rows.en: Telemetry ingestion is already available. The missing step is continuous SQL-like windowed aggregation over the stream. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Telemetry ingestion байгаа. Stream дээр тасралтгүй SQL-like windowed aggregation дутуу. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: Stream Analytics нь streaming query/window processing; Event Hubs өөрөө aggregation engine биш.

name: partitioning
trade: Partition design throughput ба query cost-д нөлөөлнө. Hot partition нь capacity байсаар байхад bottleneck болно; redistribution admin ажилтай.

rows.en: A horizontally partitioned store is throttled because most writes share one key. The redesign must spread traffic across many independent keys. What property is essential?
rows.mn: Partitioned store-ийн write ихэнх нь нэг key-д очиж throttle болно. Traffic олон key-д тараах redesign-д ямар property чухал вэ?
rows.reason: Олон утгатай бөгөөд traffic жигд тархсан key нь hotspot бууруулна; cardinality дангаараа хангалтгүй.

rows.en: A datastore supports transactions only inside one logical partition. Related records must be updated atomically. What should guide the partition design?
rows.mn: Datastore зөвхөн нэг logical partition дотор transaction дэмжинэ. Related record atomic update шаарддаг. Partition-ийг юунд тулгуурлах вэ?
rows.reason: Atomic boundary нь co-location шаардана; дурын тархалт transaction-ийг partition дамнуулна.

rows.option_en: Align key with common query filters
rows.en: Most queries filter by tenant, but current partitioning forces fan-out over every tenant. Each tenant's load is within limits. What redesign reduces query fan-out?
rows.mn: Ихэнх query tenant-аар filter хийдэг ч partitioning бүх tenant руу fan-out үүсгэнэ. Tenant бүр limit дотор. Ямар redesign вэ?
rows.reason: Tenant filter-тэй нийцсэн key нь relevant partition-д чиглүүлэхэд тусална; random key query fan-out үлдээнэ.

rows.option_mn: Хэт том эсвэл hot tenant-ийг тусгаарлах
rows.en: One tenant dominates throughput despite a tenant-based key. Simply adding more low-traffic tenants will not remove the bottleneck. What should be reconsidered?
rows.mn: Tenant key ашигласан ч нэг tenant throughput-ийг эзэлнэ. Жижиг tenant нэмэх нь bottleneck арилгахгүй. Юуг өөрчлөх вэ?
rows.reason: Hot tenant-ийн partitioning/isolation-ийг дахин төлөвлө; tenant key-г сохроор хадгалах нь hotspot үлдээнэ.

name: data-retention
trade: Soft delete/versioning storage cost нэмдэг; immutability compliance хамгаалалт. Redundancy availability-г сайжруулна, logical алдааны backup биш.

rows.en: Users occasionally delete blobs accidentally. Recovery within a configured retention window is required, but write-once compliance is not. Choose the targeted protection.
rows.mn: User blob санамсаргүй устгадаг. Retention window дотор сэргээх хэрэгтэй, WORM compliance хэрэггүй. Protection сонго.
rows.reason: Soft delete нь устгасан blob-ийг retention дотор сэргээхэд зориулагдсан.

rows.en: Applications overwrite blob content and must recover earlier versions. Choose a protection that preserves previous versions after updates.
rows.mn: App blob overwrite хийдэг, update-ээс өмнөх хувилбарыг сэргээх ёстой. Ямар protection вэ?
rows.reason: Versioning update-ийн өмнөх хувилбаруудыг хадгална; redundancy logical overwrite-ийг зүгээр replication хийнэ.

rows.en: Regulated records must not be modified or deleted during a mandated retention period, even by normal writers. Which protection fits?
rows.mn: Regulated record-ийг тогтоосон хугацаанд writer ч modify/delete хийхгүй. Ямар protection вэ?
rows.reason: Immutability WORM retention/legal hold зорилгод нийцнэ; soft delete устгахыг хориглохгүй.

rows.en: The requirement is survival of a regional storage outage rather than recovery from deletion or overwrite. Which capability addresses that failure domain?
rows.mn: Шаардлага нь delete/overwrite сэргээх бус region storage outage-ийг даван туулах. Ямар capability вэ?
rows.reason: Geo redundancy өөр region-д copy үүсгэнэ; soft delete/versioning дангаараа region isolation биш.

name: cache-decisions
trade: Cache latency бууруулдаг ч consistency/invalidation ба memory cost нэмнэ. Cache failure үед origin overload-ийг тооц; primary durability-г cache-аар орлуулахгүй.

rows.en: A read-heavy catalog tolerates brief staleness. Populate cache only when requested, reading the database on a miss. Which pattern fits?
rows.mn: Read-heavy catalog түр stale байж болно. Request ирэхэд cache дүүргэж, miss үед database уншина. Ямар pattern вэ?
rows.reason: Cache-aside нь miss үед origin уншиж cache дүүргэнэ; урьдчилан бүгдийг load хийх албагүй.

rows.option_en: Read directly from the authoritative store
rows.en: Authorization decisions must reflect immediate permission revocation; the proposed cache can remain stale and has no reliable invalidation. What should this path do?
rows.mn: Permission revoke даруй нөлөөлөх ёстой, cache stale байж болох ба reliable invalidation байхгүй. Энэ path яах вэ?
rows.reason: Security decision-д stale cache тохирохгүй; authoritative store унших нь өгсөн constraint-ийг хангана.

rows.option_en: Invalidate after updating the data store
rows.option_mn: Store update-ийн дараа cache invalidate хийх
rows.en: A cache-aside application updates a record. To reduce the risk of repopulating cache with old data, which write order should it use?
rows.mn: Cache-aside app record update хийнэ. Cache хуучин data-гаар дахин дүүрэх эрсдэлийг бууруулах write order юу вэ?
rows.reason: Store update дараа invalidate хийнэ; эхэлж invalidate хийвэл concurrent read хуучныг дүүргэж болно.

rows.en: Several app instances maintain divergent private cached values. A shared cache is acceptable and should reduce independent copies. Which architecture fits?
rows.mn: Олон app instance-ийн private cache өөр өөр утгатай. Shared cache зөвшөөрсөн, тус тусдаа copy-ийг багасгана. Ямар architecture вэ?
rows.reason: Shared cache нь instance тус бүрийн тусгаар copy-г бууруулна; consistency бүрэн батлахгүй, invalidation хэрэгтэй.

name: storage-failure-domain
trade: Өргөн failure domain хамгаалалт cost нэмнэ. Cross-region replication asynchronous тул RPO тэг гэж амлахгүй; failover ажил ба app retry-г төлөвлө.

rows.en: A disposable staging dataset can be recreated after a datacenter outage. Only local hardware redundancy is required; minimize redundancy cost.
rows.mn: Staging dataset datacenter outage дараа дахин үүсгэж болно. Зөвхөн local hardware redundancy хэрэгтэй, cost багасга.
rows.reason: LRS нэг datacenter-ийн copy; zone/region хамгаалалт нэмэлт бөгөөд энд шаардлагагүй.

rows.en: Data must remain in one region while surviving a zone outage. Cross-region replication is prohibited. Choose the redundancy model.
rows.mn: Data нэг region-д үлдэж zone outage тэсвэрлэнэ. Cross-region replication хориотой. Redundancy сонго.
rows.reason: ZRS нэг region-ийн олон zone-д synchronous copy; GRS/GZRS region boundary давна.

rows.en: A secondary-region copy is required, but primary-region zone redundancy is not. The application accepts asynchronous replication and plans account failover. Choose the model.
rows.mn: Secondary region copy шаардлагатай, primary zone redundancy хэрэггүй. Async replication ба account failover зөвшөөрсөн. Model сонго.
rows.reason: GRS primary LRS ба secondary region copy; ZRS secondary region copy өгөхгүй.

rows.en: The design requires primary-region zone redundancy and an asynchronous secondary-region copy. Choose the model that combines both.
rows.mn: Primary region-ийн zone redundancy болон async secondary region copy хоёул хэрэгтэй. Хосолсон model сонго.
rows.reason: GZRS primary ZRS-ийг geo replication-тэй хослуулна; GRS primary zone redundancy өгөхгүй.

name: secondary-read
trade: Read-access geo redundancy secondary read өгөх ч write failover-ийг автоматаар шийдэхгүй. Secondary stale байж болно; app routing/admin cost нэмнэ.

rows.en: The app must read a possibly stale secondary-region endpoint before failover. Primary zone redundancy is not required. Choose the model.
rows.mn: App failover-оос өмнө stale байж болох secondary region endpoint уншина. Primary zone redundancy хэрэггүй. Model сонго.
rows.reason: RA-GRS secondary read endpoint өгнө; GRS дангаар failover-оос өмнө read access байхгүй.

rows.en: The app needs primary zone resilience and readable geo-secondary data without waiting for account failover. Choose the model.
rows.mn: App primary zone resilience ба account failover хүлээхгүй geo-secondary read шаарддаг. Model сонго.
rows.reason: RA-GZRS zone ба geo copy дээр secondary read access нэмнэ.

rows.en: The app never reads the secondary before failover, primary-zone redundancy is unnecessary, and a geo-copy is required. Avoid paying for unneeded read access.
rows.mn: App failover-оос өмнө secondary уншихгүй, primary zone redundancy хэрэггүй, geo-copy шаарддаг. Хэрэггүй read access бүү нэм.
rows.reason: GRS шаардлагатай geo-copy өгнө; RA нь ашиглахгүй нэмэлт capability.

rows.en: Data residency permits only the primary region, and the app must withstand a zone outage. Secondary-region reads are not allowed. Choose the model.
rows.mn: Data residency зөвхөн primary region зөвшөөрнө, zone outage тэсвэрлэнэ. Secondary region read хориотой. Model сонго.
rows.reason: ZRS region дотроо үлдэнэ; geo сонголтууд residency constraint зөрчинө.

name: recovery-objectives
trade: RTO/RPO нь шаардлага болохоос үйлчилгээний нэр биш. Бага target их replication/standby cost ба testing ажил шаарддаг; latency-г тусдаа хэмж.

rows.en: A business can lose at most five minutes of committed data after a disaster. Which objective expresses this tolerance?
rows.mn: Disaster үед хамгийн ихдээ таван минутын committed data алдаж болно. Энэ ямар objective вэ?
rows.reason: RPO data loss window; RTO нь service сэргээх хугацаа.

rows.en: A customer-facing service must be usable within thirty minutes after an outage is declared. Which objective is being specified?
rows.mn: Outage зарласнаас 30 минутын дотор service usable болно. Ямар objective вэ?
rows.reason: RTO restoration duration; replication lag эсвэл retention хугацаа биш.

rows.en: Auditors must be able to restore a monthly historical copy from seven years ago. Which requirement should be specified?
rows.mn: Аудитор долоон жилийн өмнөх сарын copy-г сэргээх ёстой. Ямар шаардлага вэ?
rows.reason: Retention түүхэн copy-г хэр удаан хадгалахыг заана; RPO шинэ data loss тухай.

rows.en: A service agreement limits total unplanned unavailability over a month, rather than data loss or restore history. Which target is relevant?
rows.mn: Гэрээ сард нийт unplanned unavailability-г хязгаарлана, data loss/restore history бус. Ямар target вэ?
rows.reason: Availability target нийт uptime-д хамаарна; RTO нэг recovery event-ийн duration.

name: backup-versus-dr
trade: Backup retention ба DR failover хоёр өөр хамгаалалт. Давхар хэрэгжүүлэхэд cost нэмнэ; сэргээх туршилтгүйгээр RTO хангана гэж үзэхгүй.

rows.en: A VM's files were corrupted last week. Restore a retained earlier copy; moving the current corrupted workload to another region will not help. Which service fits?
rows.mn: VM file өнгөрсөн долоо хоногт эвдэрсэн. Retained earlier copy сэргээх хэрэгтэй; одоогийн эвдэрсэн workload-ийг өөр region руу шилжүүлэх тусгүй. Service сонго.
rows.reason: Backup түүхэн restore point өгнө; replication corruption-ийг дамжуулж болно.

rows.en: VM workloads must replicate to another region with orchestrated failover and recovery plans. Long-term historical retention is a separate solution. Choose the service.
rows.mn: VM workload өөр region руу replicate, orchestrated failover/recovery plan хэрэгтэй. Long-term retention тусдаа. Service сонго.
rows.reason: Site Recovery VM disaster recovery/failover-д чиглэнэ; Backup дангаараа replicated runtime биш.

rows.en: A business needs regional failover and recovery from corruption discovered months later. Which protection combination covers both failure types?
rows.mn: Бизнес region failover болон хэдэн сарын дараа илэрсэн corruption-оос сэргээх шаардлагатай. Ямар хослол вэ?
rows.reason: Replication regional recovery, retained backup historical recovery-г хамарна; нэг нь нөгөөг орлохгүй.

rows.en: A stateless service must remain available when one datacenter zone fails within its region. Region disaster recovery and historical data are already covered. What deployment change fits?
rows.mn: Stateless service нэг zone failure үед available байна. Region DR ба historical data хамгаалагдсан. Ямар deployment өөрчлөх вэ?
rows.reason: Zone distribution local datacenter failure-г тусгаарлана; backup нь live availability биш.

name: sql-recovery
trade: HA нь local failure, geo replication regional failure, backup logical failure-д чиглэнэ. Cost ба failover endpoint/admin effort-ийг RPO/RTO-той хамт үнэл.

rows.en: An accidental SQL DELETE committed two hours ago; the database is otherwise healthy. Recover to a time before the mistake within retention.
rows.mn: SQL DELETE хоёр цагийн өмнө санамсаргүй commit болсон, database healthy. Retention дотор алдааны өмнөх цагт сэргээ.
rows.reason: PITR historical backup/log ашиглана; live replica алдааг мөн авсан байж болно.

rows.en: A supported Azure SQL tier must tolerate a primary-region zone failure without relying on another region. What should be enabled?
rows.mn: Дэмжигддэг SQL tier өөр region ашиглахгүйгээр primary region zone failure тэсвэрлэнэ. Юуг enable хийх вэ?
rows.reason: Zone redundancy local zone failure хамгаална; backup restore нь active HA-ийн оронд биш.

rows.en: A supported Azure SQL deployment needs managed geo-failover and stable listener endpoints for applications. Which capability fits?
rows.mn: Дэмжигддэг SQL deployment managed geo-failover ба app-ийн stable listener endpoint шаарддаг. Аль capability вэ?
rows.reason: Failover group нь geo failover/connection endpoint удирдлагыг багасгана.

rows.en: Compliance requires selected database backups to be retained for years, beyond ordinary point-in-time restore windows. What should be configured?
rows.mn: Compliance selected database backup-ийг энгийн PITR window-оос урт олон жил хадгална. Юуг тохируулах вэ?
rows.reason: LTR урт хугацааны backup retention; geo replica түүхэн жил бүрийн copy биш.

name: dr-validation
trade: DR plan-ийн бодит хугацааг хэмж. Test failover нь validation ажил/compute cost-тай; replication alone app dependency ба DNS-г батлахгүй.

rows.option_en: Test failover in an isolated network
rows.en: A team must validate recovery without interrupting production or exposing duplicate live services. Which exercise should it perform?
rows.mn: Production таслахгүй, duplicate live service гаргахгүй recovery шалгана. Ямар exercise вэ?
rows.reason: Isolated test failover recovery-г production-оос салгаж шалгана; unplanned failover зориуд outage үүсгэнэ.

rows.en: A controlled move is scheduled while the source is healthy. Synchronization and coordinated shutdown are possible. Which failover type fits?
rows.mn: Source healthy үед төлөвлөсөн шилжилт хийнэ, sync ба coordinated shutdown боломжтой. Ямар failover вэ?
rows.reason: Planned failover control-той sync ашиглана; disaster-ийн unplanned нөхцөл биш.

rows.en: The source region is unavailable and cannot coordinate shutdown. Recovery must use available replicated state. Which operation fits?
rows.mn: Source region unavailable, shutdown coordinate хийхгүй. Available replicated state-аар сэргээнэ. Ямар operation вэ?
rows.reason: Unplanned failover source-гүй recovery; data loss боломжийг RPO-оор үнэлнэ.

rows.en: Database, middleware and web VMs replicate correctly, but failover must start dependencies in a defined sequence with scripts. What is missing?
rows.mn: Database/middleware/web VM replicate болсон ч dependency order ба script хэрэгтэй. Юу дутуу вэ?
rows.reason: Recovery plan startup orchestration өгнө; replication setting дангаараа app order биш.

name: logical-data-protection
trade: Recovery capability бүр өөр failure-г хамарна. Version/soft-delete storage cost нэмнэ; WORM нь prevention, geo copy availability хамгаалалт.

rows.en: A storage application repeatedly overwrites valid content with incorrect values. Restore prior object versions without treating every update as prohibited.
rows.mn: Storage app зөв content-ийг буруу утгаар overwrite хийдэг. Update бүрийг хориглохгүйгээр prior version сэргээ.
rows.reason: Versioning нь update history; immutability update-г хориглоно, redundancy overwrite-ийг replicate хийнэ.

rows.en: A user deletes an object and notices immediately. A configured recovery window must allow undelete. Which feature targets this event?
rows.mn: User object устгаад шууд анзаарсан. Тохируулсан window-д undelete хийх ёстой. Аль feature вэ?
rows.reason: Soft delete устгасан object recovery-д чиглэнэ; versioning/replication-ийг бүх delete protection гэж үзэхгүй.

rows.en: A regulatory archive must reject modification and deletion until its retention obligation ends. Recovery after deletion alone is insufficient.
rows.mn: Regulatory archive retention дуустал modify/delete request-ийг хориглоно. Устгасны дараах recovery хүрэхгүй.
rows.reason: Immutability prevention өгнө; soft delete нь delete request-ийг заавал хориглохгүй.

rows.en: The primary region is inaccessible, but there is no logical corruption. Recovery requires data outside the affected region. Which protection addresses the location risk?
rows.mn: Primary region unavailable, logical corruption байхгүй. Өртсөн region-оос гаднах data хэрэгтэй. Ямар protection вэ?
rows.reason: Geo replication geographic failure тусгаарлана; local version history өөр region copy биш.

name: redundancy-limits
trade: Redundancy-ийн failure domain ба replication lag-ийг бизнесийн requirement-тай тулга. Нэмэлт copy cost-тай; app endpoint failover ба retry ажил тусдаа.

rows.en: An LRS account must now survive a zone-wide outage while staying in the same region. Which change directly addresses the new failure domain?
rows.mn: LRS account нэг region-д үлдээд zone-wide outage тэсвэрлэх шинэ шаардлагатай. Ямар өөрчлөлт вэ?
rows.reason: Zone redundancy нь datacenter failure domain-ийг тэлнэ; local copy тоо дангаар хангахгүй.

rows.en: A ZRS account must now retain a copy after an entire region is lost. Cross-region replication is allowed. Which capability must be added?
rows.mn: ZRS account бүтэн region алдагдсаны дараа copy үлдээх ёстой. Cross-region зөвшөөрсөн. Юу нэмэх вэ?
rows.reason: Geo redundancy region boundary давна; ZRS дангаараа region failure хамгаалахгүй.

rows.en: Geo-replication is enabled, but administrators fear valid credentials overwriting data in both regions. What additional protection addresses this?
rows.mn: Geo replication байгаа ч valid credential хоёр region-ийн data-г overwrite хийхээс айж байна. Ямар нэмэлт хамгаалалт вэ?
rows.reason: Historical protection logical overwrite-оос сэргээнэ; synchronous/async replication дангаараа хуучин утга хадгалахгүй.

rows.en: A design claims asynchronous geo-replication guarantees zero loss of all acknowledged recent writes after regional failure. What review action is required?
rows.mn: Design async geo replication region failure үед бүх acknowledged recent write zero loss гэжээ. Review ямар action хийх вэ?
rows.reason: Async replication lag байдаг тул zero-loss claim үндэслэлгүй; RPO/design-ийг дахин үнэлнэ.

name: availability-design
trade: Replica/standby cost ба failover complexity ихэснэ. HA ба DR нь latency, failure domain, RPO/RTO-гийн шаардлагыг тус тус хангах ёстой.

rows.en: A service must recover automatically from host failure without changing regions. Regional disaster recovery is already handled. Which layer addresses this?
rows.mn: Host failure-оос region солихгүй автоматаар сэргээнэ. Region DR тусдаа бий. Ямар layer вэ?
rows.reason: Local HA host failure-г хамарна; geo recovery илүү том failure domain.

rows.en: A design already survives individual hosts and zones but must continue after an entire region fails. Which capability is still missing?
rows.mn: Host/zone failure тэсвэрлэдэг боловч бүтэн region failure дараа үргэлжлэх ёстой. Юу дутуу вэ?
rows.reason: Regional DR нь region boundary давсан recovery; local HA хүрэлцэхгүй.

rows.en: All replicas are healthy but contain a bad update replicated from the primary. The business needs the state before that update. Which recovery approach fits?
rows.mn: Бүх replica healthy ч primary-ийн буруу update бүгдэд очсон. Update-ээс өмнөх state хэрэгтэй. Ямар recovery вэ?
rows.reason: Historical restore нь logical mistake-ээс өмнөх state; replica failover буруу data-г хэвээр үлдээнэ.

rows.en: The database fails over successfully but clients retain broken connections and report errors. Which application capability must be added?
rows.mn: Database failover амжилттай ч client broken connection бариад алдана. App-д ямар capability хэрэгтэй вэ?
rows.reason: Retry/reconnection нь transient failover алдааг зохицуулна; replica нэмэх нь client connection logic засахгүй.

name: traffic-layer
trade: Global/regional ба L4/L7-ийг эхэлж ялга. Proxy feature cost/latency нэмнэ; DNS failover нь cache TTL ба client behavior-оос хамаарна.

rows.en: A public HTTP application spans regions and requires global Layer 7 routing, edge TLS termination and WAF. Which entry service fits?
rows.mn: Public HTTP app олон region-той, global L7 routing, edge TLS termination, WAF шаарддаг. Entry service сонго.
rows.reason: Front Door global HTTP reverse proxy; Traffic Manager DNS тул TLS/WAF proxy биш.

rows.en: A regional web workload needs private frontend access, URL path routing and WAF within its regional network design. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Regional web workload private frontend, URL path routing, WAF хэрэгтэй. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: Application Gateway regional L7 proxy/private frontend; Front Door global public edge өөр загвар.

rows.en: A regional TCP service needs Layer 4 distribution without HTTP inspection or TLS termination. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Regional TCP service HTTP inspection/TLS termination-гүй L4 distribution хүснэ. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: Load Balancer TCP/UDP L4; HTTP proxy нь arbitrary TCP-ийн орлуулагч биш.

rows.en: An existing cross-region service needs DNS-based endpoint selection; connections must go directly to endpoints without a new reverse proxy. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Cross-region service DNS-based endpoint selection хүснэ, connection шинэ proxy-гүй endpoint руу шууд очно. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: Traffic Manager DNS selection; Front Door connection proxy хийдэг тул constraint өөр.

name: private-connectivity
trade: Private access нь authentication-ийг орлохгүй. DNS/network policy admin ажил нэмэгдэнэ; private endpoint hourly/data cost ба DR endpoint-ийг тооц.

rows.en: A PaaS service must be reached using a private IP in a VNet, and public access will be disabled. Which connectivity primitive fits?
rows.mn: PaaS service VNet-ийн private IP-аар хүрдэг, public access disabled болно. Ямар primitive вэ?
rows.reason: Private Endpoint service-д private IP өгнө; service endpoint нь public endpoint-ийг private IP болгохгүй.

rows.en: An Azure subnet must be authorized to a supported PaaS public endpoint via its VNet identity; no private IP endpoint is required. Which option fits?
rows.mn: Azure subnet supported PaaS public endpoint-д VNet identity-аар authorized болно; private IP endpoint хэрэггүй. Аль option вэ?
rows.reason: Service endpoint subnet identity ашиглана; private endpoint нь өөр private IP загвар.

rows.en: Two Azure VNets need direct private IP connectivity to each other's VM networks. PaaS endpoint access is not the task. What fits?
rows.mn: Хоёр VNet-ийн VM network хооронд direct private IP connectivity хэрэгтэй. PaaS endpoint биш. Юу тохирох вэ?
rows.reason: Peering VNet хооронд холбодог; private endpoint нь service endpoint mapping.

rows.en: An on-premises network must access Azure private addresses over an encrypted internet tunnel. Which component fits?
rows.mn: On-prem network Azure private address руу encrypted internet tunnel-аар орно. Ямар component вэ?
rows.reason: VPN Gateway tunnel connectivity өгнө; peering on-prem site-тэй шууд VPN үүсгэхгүй.

name: hybrid-link
trade: Dedicated circuit нь cost/lead time нэмнэ; VPN internet variability-тай. Private connectivity дангаараа encryption guarantee биш; HA-д redundant path төлөвлө.

rows.en: A datacenter needs provider-based private connectivity to Microsoft networks rather than internet-based VPN transport. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Datacenter internet VPN transport бус provider-based private connectivity хүснэ. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: ExpressRoute private circuit; VPN public internet tunnel тул transport constraint зөрчинө.

rows.en: A small branch has compatible VPN equipment and needs an encrypted tunnel over its existing internet connection. Avoid a dedicated carrier circuit.
rows.mn: Жижиг салбар VPN device-тай, existing internet дээр encrypted tunnel хэрэгтэй. Dedicated carrier circuit авахгүй.
rows.reason: S2S VPN site network холбодог; ExpressRoute dedicated connection шаарддаг.

rows.en: Individual remote engineers need encrypted access from their laptops to a VNet without a branch VPN device. Which connection type fits?
rows.mn: Remote инженерүүд laptop-оос VNet руу encrypted access авна, branch VPN device байхгүй. Ямар төрөл вэ?
rows.reason: P2S client laptop-д зориулагдсан; S2S site gateway шаарддаг.

rows.en: Two Azure VNets need private connectivity without an on-premises network or VPN tunnel. Which mechanism is simplest among these?
rows.mn: Хоёр Azure VNet private холбогдоно, on-prem/tunnel шаардлагагүй. Эдгээрээс аль нь тохирох вэ?
rows.reason: Peering Azure VNet network-уудыг холбоно; carrier circuit/VPN нь шаардлагагүй нэмэлт бүрэлдэхүүн.

name: network-topology
trade: Hub shared service cost-ийг хуваалцана, routing/inspection bottleneck үүсгэж болно. Peering transitivity-г бүү таамагла; redundancy ба route testing хэрэгтэй.

rows.en: Several isolated workload networks need shared connectivity and central inspection services. Which topology organizes these responsibilities?
rows.mn: Олон isolated workload network shared connectivity ба central inspection ашиглана. Ямар topology вэ?
rows.reason: Hub shared network service, spoke workload isolation-д зориулагдсан.

rows.en: Two spokes are each peered to the hub. Designers assume that this automatically provides transitive connectivity between spokes. What is required?
rows.mn: Хоёр spoke тус бүр hub-тэй peered. Энэ нь spoke хооронд automatic transitive connection гэж үзжээ. Юу хэрэгтэй вэ?
rows.reason: Peering transitive биш; direct peering эсвэл routing/forwarding-ийн explicit design шаардлагатай.

rows.en: Spoke egress must traverse a central inspection appliance rather than its default outbound route. Which routing configuration is needed?
rows.mn: Spoke egress default outbound бус central inspection appliance-аар дамжина. Ямар routing хэрэгтэй вэ?
rows.reason: UDR next hop-оор inspection path чиглүүлнэ; hub байгаа төдийд traffic автоматаар дамжихгүй.

rows.en: Spokes should reuse the hub's supported VPN gateway instead of deploying a gateway in each spoke. Which peering feature should be designed?
rows.mn: Spoke бүр gateway үүсгэхгүйгээр hub-ийн supported VPN gateway-г ашиглана. Ямар feature төлөвлөх вэ?
rows.reason: Gateway transit shared gateway reuse; энгийн peering дангаараа gateway reuse тохируулга биш.

name: compute-control
trade: Managed compute patching/admin ажлыг бууруулна; control хэрэгтэй бол IaaS/cluster cost нэмнэ. Scale/zone/DR supported plan-ийг тусад нь сонго.

rows.en: A conventional web API needs managed hosting and deployment slots, with no custom OS modules or Kubernetes API requirement. Minimize platform operations.
rows.mn: Энгийн web API managed hosting/deployment slot хүснэ, custom OS module/Kubernetes API хэрэггүй. Platform operations багасга.
rows.reason: App Service web hosting-д чиглэсэн managed platform; VM/AKS шаардлагагүй control нэмнэ.

rows.en: A vendor application requires a custom kernel driver and administrator access to the operating system. Which compute option meets this hard constraint?
rows.mn: Vendor app custom kernel driver ба OS admin access шаарддаг. Аль compute энэ hard constraint-ийг хангах вэ?
rows.reason: VM guest OS control өгнө; managed web/container platform kernel control өгөхгүй.

rows.en: A platform team requires direct Kubernetes API access, custom controllers and cluster-level orchestration configuration. Which managed service fits?
rows.mn: Platform team Kubernetes API, custom controller, cluster-level orchestration шаарддаг. Ямар managed service вэ?
rows.reason: AKS Kubernetes control хэрэгцээнд нийцнэ; Container Apps direct cluster API өгөхгүй.

rows.en: Microservices must run containers with event-driven scaling and managed revisions, without managing Kubernetes clusters. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Microservice container, event-driven scaling, managed revision хүснэ; Kubernetes cluster удирдахгүй. Service сонго.
rows.reason: Container Apps managed container platform; AKS илүү cluster administration шаардана.

name: compute-workload
trade: Ажлын хугацаа/trigger/control нь compute сонголтыг шийднэ. Consumption зардал багасч болох ч cold start/limit-ийг тооц; HA тохиргоо тусдаа.

rows.en: A small unit of code should run when a supported event arrives, using managed bindings and no server administration. Which compute model fits?
rows.mn: Supported event ирэхэд жижиг code ажиллаж managed binding ашиглана, server удирдахгүй. Ямар model вэ?
rows.reason: Functions event-triggered code-д чиглэнэ; batch scheduler том job orchestration-д зориулагдсан.

rows.en: Thousands of independent compute jobs need managed scheduling across a pool of compute nodes. Which service targets this workload?
rows.mn: Мянга мянган independent compute job node pool дээр managed scheduling шаардана. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: Batch parallel/batch job scheduling-д зориулагдсан; нэг event function бүх pool scheduler биш.

rows.en: Run a short-lived standalone container group with no cluster management, no revision-based microservice platform and no autoscaling requirement. Choose the simplest fit.
rows.mn: Богино настай standalone container group ажиллуулна; cluster/revision platform/autoscaling хэрэггүй. Тохирох service сонго.
rows.reason: ACI standalone container execution; AKS/Container Apps-ийн orchestration requirement байхгүй.

rows.en: A stateless workload requires identical VMs with OS-level control and scaling the VM instance count. Which compute structure fits?
rows.mn: Stateless workload OS control-той ижил VM-үүдийн instance count-ийг scale хийнэ. Ямар structure вэ?
rows.reason: VM Scale Sets VM fleet scale хийнэ; Functions/ACI ижил IaaS control model биш.

name: messaging-choice
trade: Queue delivery semantics, stream replay, event notification-ийг ялга. Throughput/cost ба consumer operation trade-off; message processing idempotency-г тусдаа бод.

rows.en: Each business command must be processed by one competing worker, with dead-letter handling and reliable broker semantics. Which messaging primitive fits?
rows.mn: Business command бүрийг competing worker-оос нэг нь боловсруулж dead-letter handling хэрэгтэй. Ямар primitive вэ?
rows.reason: Service Bus queue work distribution/advanced broker semantics; stream нь queue lock/settlement загвар биш.

rows.en: Each order event must reach billing and shipping independently, with separate durable subscriber queues and filters. What fits?
rows.mn: Order event billing ба shipping-д тус тусдаа durable subscriber queue/filter-тэй очно. Юу тохирох вэ?
rows.reason: Topic/subscription durable pub-sub; ганц queue consumer-ууд work-ийг хуваана.

rows.en: High-volume device telemetry must be retained as a stream and replayed independently by multiple analytic consumers. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Их telemetry stream хэлбэрээр retained, олон analytics consumer тусдаа replay хийнэ. Ямар service вэ?
rows.reason: Event Hubs partitioned stream/replay-д чиглэнэ; Service Bus command workflow өөр.

rows.en: A storage event should notify an event handler when a new object appears. No ordered command queue or historical stream replay is required. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Шинэ object гарвал storage event handler-д мэдэгдэнэ. Ordered command queue/history replay хэрэггүй. Service сонго.
rows.reason: Event Grid reactive event routing; analytics stream retention эсвэл command broker шаардлагагүй.

name: messaging-features
trade: Broker feature сонгохдоо throughput/session bottleneck ба duplicate business effect-ийг тооц. HA нь retry, settlement, idempotency-г орлохгүй.

rows.en: Messages for each order must be processed in order, while different orders can proceed independently. Which broker feature should group them?
rows.mn: Order бүрийн message дарааллаар, өөр order-ууд зэрэг боловсруулагдана. Ямар broker feature вэ?
rows.reason: Session related messages-ийн ordered handling; random consumer distribution order guarantee биш.

rows.en: A producer may resend the same MessageId after a network timeout. Suppress duplicate sends within a configured broker detection window. Which feature fits?
rows.mn: Producer timeout дараа ижил MessageId дахин явуулж болно. Broker window дотор duplicate send-ийг дарах feature вэ?
rows.reason: Duplicate detection send duplicate-ийг window дотор шүүнэ; end-to-end business exactly-once баталгаа биш.

rows.en: Poison messages repeatedly fail processing and must be isolated for investigation rather than blocking ordinary work. Which destination fits?
rows.mn: Poison message дахин дахин fail болж, бусад ажлыг хаахгүй тусгаарлаж шалгана. Ямар destination вэ?
rows.reason: DLQ failed/unprocessable message тусгаарлана; session нь error investigation queue биш.

rows.en: Billing wants only invoice-related messages while logistics wants shipment-related ones from the same topic. Which feature routes the relevant subset?
rows.mn: Нэг topic-оос billing зөвхөн invoice, logistics зөвхөн shipment message авна. Ямар feature вэ?
rows.reason: Subscription filter relevant subset сонгоно; duplicate detection business category routing биш.

name: application-integration
trade: Workflow orchestration admin effort ба custom code flexibility-г харьцуул. Connector/service call latency, retry cost, idempotency ба DR-ийг тооц.

rows.en: A business process must connect SaaS systems using managed connectors and visual workflow orchestration. Minimize custom integration code.
rows.mn: Бизнес процесс SaaS системүүдийг managed connector ба visual workflow-оор холбоно. Custom integration code багасга.
rows.reason: Logic Apps connector/workflow integration; VM-based custom code нэмэлт operations шаардана.

rows.en: A workflow needs a custom event-triggered calculation implemented as code, rather than a connector-only business process. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Workflow custom event-triggered calculation code шаарддаг, connector-only process биш. Service сонго.
rows.reason: Functions custom code execution-д тохирно; visual orchestration өөр abstraction.

rows.en: Existing APIs need a managed facade for policies, consumer access, throttling and API publishing. The backend compute already exists. What is missing?
rows.mn: Backend API байгаа, policy/consumer access/throttling/publishing бүхий facade дутуу. Юу хэрэгтэй вэ?
rows.reason: API Management API facade/control; compute hosting эсвэл event bus өөр үүрэгтэй.

rows.en: Independent services should react to published events without embedding every destination in the publisher. Which event-routing service fits?
rows.mn: Publisher destination бүрийг embed хийхгүй, independent service event-д react хийнэ. Ямар event-routing service вэ?
rows.reason: Event Grid event distribution; APIM synchronous API facade, workflow orchestration өөр үүрэг.

name: migration-path
trade: Өөрчлөлт бага migration хурдан ч cloud efficiency сул байж болно. Refactor/rearchitect development effort нэмнэ; availability ба cutover risk-ийг хэмж.

rows.en: A legacy app must move quickly with minimal code change, retaining its VM operating model initially. Which migration strategy fits?
rows.mn: Legacy app хурдан, code бага өөрчлөөд эхэндээ VM operating model-оо хадгалж нүүнэ. Strategy сонго.
rows.reason: Rehost infrastructure relocation; redesign хийвэл хугацаа/code constraint зөрчинө.

rows.en: An application can move to a managed hosting platform with limited changes while keeping its core architecture. Which strategy fits?
rows.mn: App core architecture-аа хадгалаад бага өөрчлөлтөөр managed hosting руу нүүнэ. Strategy сонго.
rows.reason: Replatform platform-ийг өөрчилнө, бүрэн architecture redesign биш.

rows.en: A monolith must be redesigned into independently scalable services to meet new business requirements. Which strategy fits?
rows.mn: Monolith шинэ шаардлагаар independently scalable service-үүд болж redesign хийгдэнэ. Strategy сонго.
rows.reason: Rearchitect application structure-ийг өөрчилнө; rehost нь энэ өөрчлөлт хийхгүй.

rows.en: Discovery shows an application has no remaining users, dependencies or retention obligation. Moving it would add cost without value. Which action fits?
rows.mn: Discovery app хэрэглэгч/dependency/retention obligation-гүйг тогтоов. Нүүлгэх нь хэрэггүй зардал. Ямар action вэ?
rows.reason: Retire хэрэггүй workload-ийг зогсооно; бусад strategy хэрэггүй нөөцийг cloud-д үлдээнэ.

name: migration-assessment
trade: Assessment нь sizing/cost ба dependency эрсдэлийг багасгана; migration execution-аас тусдаа. Түүхэн utilization ба cutover window бодитоор хэмж.

rows.en: The team does not know which servers and applications exist. Before sizing or moving anything, what activity is required?
rows.mn: Баг ямар server/app байгааг мэдэхгүй. Sizing/move-оос өмнө юу хийх вэ?
rows.reason: Inventory migration population тодруулна; replication хийхээс өмнө source-оо мэдэх хэрэгтэй.

rows.en: Servers are inventoried, but migration waves must keep communicating application components together. Which analysis is missing?
rows.mn: Server inventory байгаа, migration wave харилцдаг component-уудыг хамт байлгана. Ямар analysis дутуу вэ?
rows.reason: Dependency analysis communication холбоосыг тодруулна; size report wave dependency-г дангаар харуулахгүй.

rows.en: A target estimate must account for compatibility and observed resource utilization instead of copying oversized VM allocations. What should be performed?
rows.mn: Target estimate compatibility ба observed utilization-д тулгуурлана, хэт том VM allocation-ийг хуулж болохгүй. Юу хийх вэ?
rows.reason: Assessment readiness/right-sizing үнэлнэ; шууд migration oversized cost хадгалж болно.

rows.en: Replication is configured and the cutover plan exists. Validate the migrated workload in isolation before switching production. Which next step fits?
rows.mn: Replication ба cutover plan байгаа. Production switch-ээс өмнө migrated workload тусгаар туршина. Дараагийн алхам вэ?
rows.reason: Test migration behavior/connectivity validation; inventory энэ runtime validation-ийг орлохгүй.

name: egress-security
trade: NAT, firewall, NSG, WAF өөр layer-ийн control. Inspection нь cost/latency/admin ажил нэмнэ; нэгийг бүх хамгаалалт гэж үзэхгүй.

rows.en: Private VMs need scalable outbound internet connectivity using predictable public source IPs. No traffic inspection is required. Which component fits?
rows.mn: Private VM predictable public source IP-аар scalable outbound internet авна. Traffic inspection хэрэггүй. Component сонго.
rows.reason: NAT Gateway outbound SNAT; firewall inspection шаардлагагүй нэмэлт complexity.

rows.en: Multiple spokes need centralized stateful network/application filtering and managed security rules for outbound traffic. Which service fits?
rows.mn: Олон spoke outbound traffic-д centralized stateful network/application filtering ба managed rule хүснэ. Service сонго.
rows.reason: Azure Firewall central inspection; NAT нь filtering engine биш, NSG нь application rule ижил биш.

rows.en: A subnet requires basic allow/deny rules by IP, port and protocol, with no HTTP inspection or centralized application filtering. Which control fits?
rows.mn: Subnet IP/port/protocol-оор basic allow/deny, HTTP inspection/central app filtering хэрэггүй. Control сонго.
rows.reason: NSG L3/L4 access filtering; WAF HTTP-layer, NAT security policy биш.

rows.en: A public web application needs inspection for common HTTP attacks such as SQL injection. Which security layer fits?
rows.mn: Public web app SQL injection зэрэг HTTP attack inspection шаарддаг. Ямар security layer вэ?
rows.reason: WAF web attack inspection; NSG port/IP filter payload SQL injection танихгүй.

name: dns-routing
trade: DNS routing connection proxy биш. Client caching ба health probe interval failover хугацаанд нөлөөлнө; latency/cost trade-off-ийг global хэмжээнд үнэл.

rows.en: A DNS traffic service must send requests to a preferred endpoint unless it is unhealthy, then use a standby. Which routing method fits?
rows.mn: DNS traffic service preferred endpoint healthy үед түүнийг, unhealthy үед standby ашиглана. Method сонго.
rows.reason: Priority active/passive preference; weighted нь percentage distribution-д зориулагдсан.

rows.en: A rollout should distribute new DNS responses approximately between two healthy endpoints according to configured weights. Which method fits?
rows.mn: Rollout шинэ DNS response-уудыг healthy endpoint-уудад weight-ийн дагуу ойролцоогоор хуваарилна. Method сонго.
rows.reason: Weighted relative weight distribution; exact per-request percentage DNS cache-аас шалтгаалж батлахгүй.

rows.en: Users should be directed by a DNS traffic service to the endpoint expected to provide lower network latency based on its routing model. Which method fits?
rows.mn: DNS traffic service routing model-оор бага network latency-тай гэж тооцсон endpoint сонгоно. Method сонго.
rows.reason: Performance latency-oriented routing; priority нь fixed preference, geography нь region mapping.

rows.en: DNS query origins must map to designated geographic endpoint groups according to a location-based routing policy. Which method fits?
rows.mn: DNS query origin location-based policy-ийн designated geographic endpoint group-д map хийнэ. Method сонго.
rows.reason: Geographic location mapping; performance latency сонгоно. Энэ нь дангаараа data residency enforcement биш.

name: resilience-patterns
trade: Resilience pattern буруу retry storm үүсгэж болно. Latency, queue backlog, extra capacity cost ба операцийн monitoring-ийг хамтад нь төлөвлө.

rows.en: A dependency occasionally returns transient errors and operations are safe to retry. Avoid synchronized immediate retries. Which pattern fits?
rows.mn: Dependency түр зуурын error өгдөг, operation retry-safe. Бүгд зэрэг шууд retry хийхээс зайлсхий. Pattern сонго.
rows.reason: Backoff transient failure-ийн дараах retry load тараана; persistent failure-г endlessly retry хийхгүй.

rows.en: A dependency fails persistently and repeated calls exhaust resources. Temporarily stop calls and probe for recovery. Which pattern fits?
rows.mn: Dependency байнга fail болж давтан call resource шавхаж байна. Түр call зогсоож recovery probe хийнэ. Pattern сонго.
rows.reason: Circuit breaker persistent failure үед fail-fast; retry дангаараа load нэмэгдүүлж болно.

rows.en: Incoming work arrives in bursts, but workers should process at a sustainable rate and delayed completion is acceptable. Which pattern fits?
rows.mn: Work burst-ээр ирнэ, worker sustainable rate-аар боловсруулна, delay зөвшөөрнө. Pattern сонго.
rows.reason: Queue backlog burst шингээнэ; cache нь work scheduling buffer биш.

rows.en: One tenant's failing workload must not exhaust every connection or worker needed by other tenants. Which pattern fits?
rows.mn: Нэг tenant-ийн failing workload бусдын connection/worker-ийг бүгдийг шавхахгүй. Pattern сонго.
rows.reason: Bulkhead resource pool тусгаарлаж failure spread бууруулна; retry дангаараа isolation биш.

name: api-gateway-controls
trade: Gateway policy төвлөрүүлэх нь admin ажлыг багасгана ч additional hop/cost өгнө. Rate limit/caching нь backend authorization ба DR-ийг орлохгүй.

rows.en: An API consumer may send short bursts that overload a backend. Enforce a bounded request rate per consumer. Which gateway policy fits?
rows.mn: API consumer богино burst-ээр backend overload болгоно. Consumer бүрийн request rate хязгаарла. Policy сонго.
rows.reason: Rate limiting хугацааны богино window-д request rate хянадаг; cache нь per-consumer limit биш.

rows.en: A product subscription includes a fixed request allowance over a longer billing period. Which policy primarily models that allowance?
rows.mn: Product subscription урт billing period-д тогтсон request allowance-тай. Аль policy голчлон үүнийг илэрхийлэх вэ?
rows.reason: Quota cumulative allowance-д зориулагдсан; rate limit нь short-window pacing.

rows.en: Identical safe read requests repeatedly fetch unchanged public data. Reduce backend calls while allowing bounded staleness. Which capability fits?
rows.mn: Ижил safe read request өөрчлөгдөөгүй public data авдаг. Bounded stale зөвшөөрч backend call багасга. Capability сонго.
rows.reason: Caching reuse өгнө; quota/rate limit нь response reuse биш.

rows.en: The gateway must reject requests whose presented token fails issuer, audience or signature validation before forwarding. Which policy fits?
rows.mn: Gateway issuer/audience/signature validation fail болсон token-той request-ийг forward хийхгүй. Policy сонго.
rows.reason: Token validation authentication claim шалгана; rate limit/cache нь token trust батлахгүй.

name: scaling-decision
trade: Scale-up limit, scale-out state, scheduling forecast, reactive delay-ийг үнэл. Extra compute cost/HA trade-off ба monitoring admin effort байна.

rows.en: A non-distributed workload needs more memory on its single instance and cannot run multiple replicas without redesign. Which immediate scaling direction fits?
rows.mn: Non-distributed workload нэг instance-д илүү memory хэрэгтэй, redesign-гүй олон replica ажиллахгүй. Шууд scaling direction юу вэ?
rows.reason: Scale-up нэг instance-ийн capacity нэмнэ; scale-out app constraint зөрчинө.

rows.en: A stateless web tier can distribute requests across identical instances. Increase total capacity and reduce reliance on one instance. Which direction fits?
rows.mn: Stateless web tier request-ийг ижил instance-уудад тараана. Нийт capacity нэмээд нэг instance-ийн хамаарлыг бууруул. Direction сонго.
rows.reason: Scale-out replica нэмнэ; scale-up ганц instance dependency хэвээр үлдээнэ.

rows.en: A predictable daily traffic surge starts at the same time and instances must be ready before it begins. Which scaling trigger fits?
rows.mn: Traffic surge өдөр бүр тогтсон цагт, instance өмнө нь бэлэн байх ёстой. Ямар trigger вэ?
rows.reason: Scheduled scaling урьдчилсан known demand-д нийцнэ; reactive threshold surge эхэлсний дараа хариулна.

rows.en: Demand is unpredictable, and instance count should react to sustained observed CPU or queue pressure within limits. Which trigger fits?
rows.mn: Demand таамаглах боломжгүй, instance count sustained CPU/queue pressure-д limit дотор хариулна. Trigger сонго.
rows.reason: Metric-based autoscale actual demand signal ашиглана; schedule таамаггүй spike-ийг зөв тааруулахгүй.
